summary: Iter68 Team Hub features verified end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass (test_iter68_team_hub_features.py). P0 To-Dos (team/competition/event scopes) — create/toggle/patch/delete + household-scoped list with done-to-bottom sorting all correct. P1.1 Signup reorder — newly created sheets float to top (order lower than min), POST /api/team/signups/reorder persists new order, list sorts by order asc on reload. P1.2 Attendance — session CRUD, PUT /mark with present/absent/excused/null works, roster_total EXCLUDES role='parent' (verified with 2 athletes + 1 parent seed), summary counts (present/absent/excused/unmarked/member_total) computed correctly, invalid member returns 404. P1.3 Event↔Signup link — GET /api/team/signups?event_id filter restricts correctly, event_id persists on create. P2.4 Roster expanded — preferred_name/food_allergies/other_allergies/medical_concerns/host_bonding_opt_in persist on create + PATCH; RosterColumn CRUD (blank rejected, rename, delete) works; member.custom values save via POST + PATCH; delete column cascades $unset on all members. P2.5 Blocks — solo owner GET /api/team/blocks/signup/{id} returns is_owner=true, members=[], blocked_user_ids=[]; PUT /api/team/blocks with non-household user returns 404. Frontend UI: /team/todos add + toggle + delete works (rows update, 'X left · Y done' counter shows, checked items strike-through and sink); /team/attendance modal creates session and navigates to session screen; mark-all-present sets 4/4 present; per-member att-mark-*-present|absent|excused testIDs render (13 buttons across 4 rows + Mark-all); /team/roster-new form renders First/Last/Preferred name, Role chips, Teams multi-select, Parent/guardian, Food allergies, Other allergies, Medical concerns, Host bonding, Custom fields section with roster-col-new-input + roster-col-add-btn — all present. Signups list correctly hides signups-reorder-toggle when <2 sheets exist. Sheet-access lock controls correctly HIDDEN on /team/signups, /team/payments, /team/paperwork for the solo owner (useCanManageAccess=false). One deprecation console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — surfaced from a dependency, non-blocking, reported as minor.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' logged from multiple screens (todos/attendance/roster-new/signups). Likely from a third-party lib or a component still using the prop form. Non-blocking but should be tracked; grep the codebase for `pointerEvents=` on JSX props and move to `style={{pointerEvents:'none'}}`.

action_items: (Optional) migrate remaining `pointerEvents` JSX props to `style.pointerEvents` to silence RN-Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/todos.py list_todos (L18-25): scope='team' + ref_id=None correctly filters Team Hub list; sorting done-to-bottom with (done, order, created_at) tuple is correct. `q['ref_id'] = ref_id` explicitly matches None which is exactly what we want for the Team Hub list.
backend/routers/attendance.py _roster_total (L21-22): parent exclusion via {'role': {'$ne': 'parent'}} is correct. member_total in summary drives 'X/N present' in UI — solid.
backend/routers/attendance.py mark_attendance (L102-117): validates roster member belongs to household and status=None pops the record (correct clear semantics). PUT idempotent.

backend/routers/signups.py create_signup (L54-63): order = min(existing_orders) - 1 → new sheet floats to top. list_signups sorts by (order asc, created_at asc). Reorder endpoint L66-73 uses enumerate index as new order — clean.
backend/routers/roster.py delete_roster_column (L223-233): after DELETE, runs update_many({user_id∈household}, {'$unset': {f'custom.{column_id}': ''}}) — cascade cleanup verified.

backend/routers/blocks.py get_blocks (L15-43): correctly returns {is_owner:false, members:[], blocked_user_ids:[]} for non-owners so the UI can hide the lock icon without a separate call. For solo owners, member_user_ids excludes owner_id so `members` is [] — matches P2.5 spec exactly.
backend/core/models.py Todo/AttendanceSession/SheetBlock/RosterColumn: literal enums for scope/status/resource are strict — bad payloads correctly fail validation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (todos add/toggle/delete, attendance create+mark-all+per-member, roster-new all P2.4 fields+custom cols, signups reorder toggle correctly gated, lock icons correctly hidden for solo owner on signups/payments/paperwork)
